What THC drinks are on the BUZZY menu right now?

Swipe through the cooler below. This carousel pulls straight from BUZZY’s live menu, so what you see is what’s actually in stock today, and you can add a can to your cart without leaving the page.

As of October 2026, the lineup is led by Ayrloom, with TUNE rounding it out. Here’s how the cans compare:

Ayrloom: New York’s first cannabis beverage

Ayrloom is the cannabis arm of Beak & Skiff, the apple orchard outside Syracuse, and its 1:1 can was reported as the first cannabis beverage released in New York State. That orchard background shows up in the flavors: Honeycrisp, Cranberry Apple and a cider-style Rosé sit next to Root Beer, Vanilla Cola and Lemonade. If you’re new to THC drinks, the 5 mg Honeycrisp 1:1 is the gentlest can in the cooler.

TUNE: a straight-THC option

TUNE Blueberry Lemonade is a 12 oz can with 10 mg of THC and no added CBD, a good pick if you already know how a 10 mg dose feels and want a bright, lemonade-style drink.

What are THC drinks?

THC drinks are beverages infused with tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), the compound in cannabis that produces its familiar high. They come in cans, bottles, shots and powdered drink mixes, and in New York’s licensed market every product lists its THC content in milligrams on the label. Because the dose is fixed per can, drinks are one of the easiest cannabis formats to understand: one can, one known amount.

Many THC drinks also include a second cannabinoid such as CBD or CBC. That’s what the ratio on the label tells you, and it’s worth reading before you choose (more on that below).

How long do THC drinks take to kick in?

Many people feel a THC drink sooner than a gummy or a brownie. Ayrloom’s president has said effects from its cans can start within 15 to 20 minutes. Still, a drink is swallowed and digested like any edible, so timing varies with your body, your tolerance and what you’ve eaten.

A good rule: sip slowly, then wait at least an hour before opening a second can. Effects from ingested cannabis can keep building for a while after the first sip, and that delay is the most common reason people take more than they meant to. For a fuller picture of how a single dose plays out, read our guide to 10 mg edible effects.

How much THC is in a THC drink?

Every drink on BUZZY’s menu right now contains either 5 mg or 10 mg of THC per can. Here’s how to think about those numbers:

  • Under 5 mg (half a can): a good place to start if you’ve never had cannabis or haven’t in years.
  • 5 mg: a light, social dose for many people. Ayrloom’s 1:1 Honeycrisp is the 5 mg pick on the menu.
  • 10 mg: a standard full serving. Most of the cooler sits here, so this is where experienced drinkers usually land.

Not sure where you fall? Ask a BUZZY budtender. They can walk you through the cans by dose and flavor.

What do 1:1 and 2:1 ratios mean on a THC drink?

The ratio compares THC to the drink’s second cannabinoid. A 2:1 can, like Ayrloom Root Beer, has twice as much THC as CBD (10 mg THC to 5 mg CBD). A 1:1 can has equal parts, like Honeycrisp (5 mg THC, 5 mg CBD) or Rosé (10 mg THC, 10 mg CBC). Many shoppers describe higher-CBD ratios as feeling more mellow, but experiences differ, so try one and note how it lands for you.

Are THC drinks a good alternative to alcohol?

For a lot of Brooklynites, THC drinks fill the spot a beer or glass of wine used to. You still get the ritual of cracking a cold can at a dinner party, a rooftop hang or a night in, with a dose you can read on the label. That’s a big part of why the category has grown so quickly.

Two ground rules: don’t mix THC drinks with alcohol, since the combination can hit harder than either one alone, and never drive after drinking one. Keep cans clearly labeled and stored away from kids and pets, because they look a lot like regular soda.

How do you choose the right THC drink?

  • Start with the dose. New to cannabis? Begin with 5 mg or half a 10 mg can.
  • Check the ratio. Decide between a straight-THC can (TUNE) and a THC + CBD or CBC blend (Ayrloom).
  • Pick a flavor you’d actually drink. Fruit-forward (Honeycrisp, Cranberry Apple, Blueberry Lemonade), classic soda (Root Beer, Vanilla Cola) or something wine-adjacent (Rosé).
  • Think about the setting. Single cans are made for one person, one sitting. Plan for that.
  • Ask the staff. BUZZY’s budtenders know the lineup and can point you to the right can.

THC drinks FAQ

How long does it take for a THC drink to kick in?

Many people feel a THC drink sooner than a gummy or baked edible. Ayrloom says effects from its cans can start within 15 to 20 minutes, but onset varies by person, so give it at least an hour before reaching for a second can.

How many milligrams of THC are in a THC drink?

Every can on BUZZY’s drinks menu right now has 5 mg or 10 mg of THC, printed on the label. Most are single-serve cans meant to be finished in one sitting, but you can always split one.

What does 2:1 or 1:1 mean on a THC drink?

It’s the ratio of THC to a second cannabinoid. A 2:1 Ayrloom can has 10 mg THC to 5 mg CBD; a 1:1 can has equal amounts, such as 5 mg THC and 5 mg CBD.

What THC drink brands does BUZZY carry?

BUZZY currently stocks Ayrloom (Root Beer, Rosé, Cranberry Apple, Honeycrisp, Lemonade and Vanilla Cola) and TUNE Blueberry Lemonade. The lineup rotates, so check the live menu for what’s in the cooler today.

Can I get THC drinks delivered in Brooklyn?

Yes. Adults 21+ can order THC drinks from BUZZY for same-day delivery to eligible Brooklyn addresses, or for pickup at 137 Court St in Cobble Hill.

Can I mix THC drinks with alcohol?

It’s best not to. Combining cannabis and alcohol can intensify the effects of both in ways that are hard to predict, so treat a THC drink as the drink, not a mixer for one.
